defsZh:
vt. 拴緊, 使固定, 系, 集中於, 強加於
vi. 扣緊

examples.zh: 無論何時都要扣好安全帶。

defsEn: cause to be firmly attached

defsZh: a. 有害的, 傷害的

examples.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.
Some medicines can be harmful to the body.
examples.zh: 有些藥品會對身體產生危害。

examples.en: Fear is more harmful than the sharpest of swords.

defsEn: causing or capable of causing harm

defsZh: a. 提供訊息的, 見聞廣博的

examples.en: This is a very informative article.
examples.zh: 這是篇資訊量很大的文章。

defsEn: tending to increase knowledge or dissipate ignorance

defsZh:
n. 學會, 學院, 協會
vt. 創立, 開始, 制定, 任命

examples.en: A new classroom building was built in our institute last year.
examples.zh: 去年我們學院建了一個新教學樓。

examples.en: At The Happiness Institute in Australia, a couple of hundred dollars may do the trick.
examples.zh: 在澳大利亞的快樂協會，兩百塊錢可能達到效果。

examples.en: Sami was at the art institute.

defsEn: an association organized to promote art or science or education

defsZh:
n. 裝備, 工具箱, 成套工具
[計] 成套部件; 成套零件

examples.en: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.
I need a first aid kit.

defsEn: a case for containing a set of articles

defsZh: adv. 地方性地, 區域性性地, 在當地
defsEn: by a particular locality

defsZh: n. 指導者, 良師益友
defsEn: a wise and trusted guide and advisor

defsZh:
vt. 提名, 任命, 命名
[法] 提名...為候選人, 指定, 推薦

examples.en: They nominated Calvin Coolidge for vice president.
examples.zh: 他們提名卡爾文•柯立芝為副總統。

defsEn: propose as a candidate for some honor

defsZh: vi. 選擇

examples.en: You can opt out if you like.
I opt to shield my emotions.

defsEn: select as an alternative over another

defsZh:
n. 遊行, 炫耀, 閱兵
v. 遊行, 炫耀, (使)列隊行進

examples.en: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.
examples.zh: 在回家的路上，我看到一場閱兵式。

examples.en: A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
examples.zh: 一大群人聚在一起看巡遊。

defsEn: a ceremonial procession including people marching

defsZh:
n. 醫師, 內科醫師, 解除痛苦者
[醫] 主治醫師

examples.zh: 他看到了一位內科醫師。

defsEn: a licensed medical practitioner

defsZh:
a. 波蘭的
n. 波蘭人, 上光劑, 光澤, 優雅
vt. 擦亮, 擦去, 使完美
vi. 擦亮, 變得光亮
defsEn: the property of being smooth and shiny

defsZh:
n. 郵資
[經] 郵費, 郵資
defsEn: the charge for mailing something

defsZh: a. 消遣的, 娛樂的

defsZh:

vi. 排練, 練習, 演習

examples.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.
examples.zh: 他們不是在打架，而是在排練戲劇。

defsEn: engage in a rehearsal (of)

defsZh:
n. 移動, 移居, 遷移, 排除, 切除
[醫] 切除, 除去

Rodrigo is here for tattoo removal.

defsEn: the act of removing

defsZh:
a. 滿意的, 贖罪的
[法] 令人滿意的, 令當事人滿意的, 充分的

examples.zh: 這個解釋不是很令人滿意。

examples.en: The results of the research were quite satisfactory.
examples.zh: 調查的結果十分令人滿意。

defsEn: giving satisfaction

defsZh:
a. 季節的, 依照季節的, 週期性的
[經] 季節性的, 季節的
defsEn: a worker who finds employment only in certain seasons

defsZh:
adv. [表]分開, 不相連, 分隔, 分離, 不同, 單獨, 獨立, 各自, 各別, 脫離肉體, 靈魂
[計] 分離地

examples.en: Could you wrap this separately, please?

defsEn: apart from others

defsZh:
n. 翻倒, 翻轉, 半圓酥餅, 營業額, 流通, 週轉
a. 可翻轉的

examples.zh: 這家公司去年獲得顯著的營業額增長。

defsEn: the ratio of the number of workers that had to be replaced in a given time period to the average number of workers

defsZh: a. 不必要的

examples.en: The facts proved that our worries were unnecessary.
examples.zh: 事實證明了我們的擔心是多餘的。

examples.en: If two men always have the same opinion, one of them is unnecessary.
examples.zh: 如果兩個人總是意見相同，那麼他們其中一個就沒必要了。

defsEn: not necessary

defsZh: adv. 相應地, 因此, 於是

examples.en: Accordingly I gave up my plans.
I will deal with Tom accordingly.

defsEn: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given

defsZh:
n. 蘋果, 傢伙
[醫] 蘋果
defsEn: fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh

defsZh:
a. 合適的, 可應用的
[法] 適用的, 適應的

examples.en: This law is applicable to all cases.

defsEn: capable of being applied; having relevance

defsZh:
n. 拍賣
vt. 拍賣

examples.en: The unclaimed items were auctioned off.
examples.zh: 無人領取的物品被拍賣了。

examples.en: The unclaimed items were sold at auction.
examples.zh: 無人領取的物品被拍賣了。

examples.en: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.
examples.zh: 無人領取的物品被拍賣了。

defsEn: a variety of bridge in which tricks made in excess of the contract are scored toward game; now generally superseded by contract bridge

defsZh: n. 陽臺, 戲院樓廳

examples.en: I ate breakfast on my balcony.
What are you doing on the balcony?

defsEn: an upper floor projecting from the rear over the main floor in an auditorium

defsZh:
n. 地下室, 牆腳
[化] 地下室

examples.en: I know I left it somewhere down here in the basement.
examples.zh: 我知道我把它放在地下室的某個地方了。

examples.en: They cleaned everything, from the basement to the attic.
examples.zh: 他們從地下室到閣樓都打掃了。

defsEn: the lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage

defsZh: adv. 預先

examples.en: Please let me know the schedule beforehand.
examples.zh: 請你事先把計劃告訴我。

examples.en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.
examples.zh: 萬一來不了，我會先給你打電話。

defsEn: being ahead of time or need

defsZh: a. 廚房的, 烹呼叫的

examples.en: India is a region rich in culinary culture.
examples.zh: 印度是一個烹飪文化豐富的地區。

examples.en: I dabble in the culinary arts.

defsEn: of or relating to or used in cooking

defsZh:
n. 記錄片
a. 檔案的

examples.en: He recorded a documentary and gave it to me.
examples.zh: 他錄了一個紀錄片給我。

examples.en: That documentary about the environmental crisis was a real eye-opener.
examples.zh: 這部有關環境危機的紀錄片真是令人大開眼界。

defsEn: a film or TV program presenting the facts about a person or event

defsZh:
n. (尤指經濟方面的)衰退, 下降趨勢
[電] 低迷時期

examples.en: Can the economy handle another downturn?
Will the global economy face another downturn?
What's responsible for Algeria's economic downturn?

defsEn: a worsening of business or economic activity

defsZh: n. 地震
defsEn: shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity

defsZh: a. 優雅的, 端莊的, 高雅的
defsEn: refined and tasteful in appearance or behavior or style

defsZh:
a. 過度的, 過多的, 極端的
[法] 過度的, 過分的, 額外的

examples.en: The government's expenditures are a bit excessive.
examples.zh: 政府的開支有些過頭了。

examples.en: Excessive choice results in the inability to choose.
examples.zh: 選擇太多導致無法選擇。

examples.en: Excessive drinking is one of the causes of impotence.
examples.zh: 酗酒是導致陽痿的一個因素。

defsEn: beyond normal limits

defsZh:
a. 屬類的, 一般的
[計] 一般的

examples.en: We don't sell generics in this pharmacy.
The generic name for Prozac is fluoxetine.

defsEn: a wine that is a blend of several varieties of grapes with no one grape predominating; a wine that does not carry the name of any specific grape

defsZh:
n. 爵士樂, 喧鬧
a. 爵士樂的, 喧吵的
vi. 演奏爵士樂, 跳爵士舞, 遊蕩
vt. 奏爵士樂, 使活潑
defsEn: empty rhetoric or insincere or exaggerated talk

defsZh:
n. 一生, 終生
a. 一生的, 終生的

examples.en: Communism will never be reached in my lifetime.
examples.zh: 在我有生之年，共產主義不可能達到。

examples.en: Some things I will never be able to learn in my lifetime.
examples.zh: 有些東西是我永遠也學不會的。

examples.en: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.
examples.zh: 一輩子只會出現一次像這樣的機會。

defsEn: the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)

defsZh:
n. 按摩, 揉
vt. 按摩, 揉

examples.en: She works as a massage therapist.
I want a massage. I need to relax.
examples.zh: 我想要按摩。我需要放鬆。

defsEn: kneading and rubbing parts of the body to increase circulation and promote relaxation

defsZh:
vt. 取...最大值, 使增加(或擴大)到最大限度
[計] 最大化

examples.en: You need to maximize your profits.
We need to maximize this opportunity.
He wants to maximize his productivity.

defsEn: make as big or large as possible

defsZh:
a. 溫和的, 溫柔的, 淡味的, 適度的, 輕微的, (肥皂等)軟性的
[醫] 輕的, 緩和的

examples.en: We had a mild winter last year.
This country has a mild climate.
examples.zh: 這個國家的氣候很溫和。

examples.en: It's fairly mild for this time of year.
examples.zh: 就現在這個節氣來說天氣是相當溫和了。

defsEn: moderate in type or degree or effect or force; far from extreme
